scope: Bounded historical information screen only; no account/promotion claim. Positive screen requires separately frozen native full-cost accounting before candidate qualification.
hypothesis: Learned intraday time weights preserve predictive structure lost by handcrafted summaries or uniform pooling.

article.path: /Users/rziiiii/Downloads/华泰金工 _ 基于日内量价结构的神经网络因子挖掘框架.html
article.adaptation: Value MLP plus Weight GRU and time-softmax pooling. Temporal H5 excess MSE replaces stock cross-sectional correlation; US full session replaces 240 China minutes. No turnover field, no transaction-count fabrication.

model.loss: Mean per-head MSE on training-standardized H5 SOXL minus SOXX open-to-open return, plus temporal within-training-batch squared off-diagonal head correlations
model.seed_policy: base seed shared across families and folds; equal-weight seed and head ensemble, no seed selection
model.input: SOXL/SOXX log OHLC relative own same-session first open plus log1p(volume / own full-session mean); 10 channels; training-only per-channel standardization
model.handcrafted: 12 frozen prior core summary features -> Linear(12,8), tanh, Linear(8,4), same loss, epochs and seeds

coverage: Require all genuine XNYS expected minutes (390 or early-close 210), valid OHLC/volume both assets; drop incomplete sessions jointly across arms; no synthetic minute fills. Right-pad only to batch tensor and mask padded positions before pooling.
timing: Signal after completed regular-session close+60sec; H5 label next-session open to sixth-session open, mature sixth-session open+60sec. Retain only labels mature strictly before fold cutoff; scale only train.
label: (SOXL open[t+6]/open[t+1] - 1) - (SOXX open[t+6]/open[t+1] - 1), shifts on full native daily calendar before qualified-minute filtering
selection: No tuning/selection, report all families, seeds, annual/quarterly/126-session windows. All historical windows reused research, no fresh test or forward qualification.

bootstrap.note: paired squared error improvement in label units; two control comparisons Bonferroni; does not cover unknown prior research searches
bootstrap.fold_gap_handling: Sample each fold separately at original fold length; blocks follow successive eligible observed sessions, may span omitted invalid sessions, circular wrap within fold only; concatenate sampled folds for pooled mean. No cross-fold block.

failure_policy: If any screen gate fails: not_promoted_information_gate_failed, close fixed route without rescue parameter search.
research_history_attempt_count: unknown; prior minute cards already negative; new representation not independent market evidence
cost_policy: Deferred at information-screen stage, no economic performance claim. Native accounts later require contract IBKR tiered 0/2/5bp and all 30pct risk/stability gates; no replacement of old strategy.
fold_cutoff: 00:00:00 America/New_York on day after train_end; sixth-session 09:31 ET label maturity strictly less than cutoff
ic_definition: Spearman correlation across dates of equal-head/equal-seed predictions and realized excess label, reported separately per fold
gate_rationale: Strict >0 out-of-fit paired MSE reduction tests whether fixed weighted representation adds predictive information beyond both controls. No material-return threshold or portfolio claim; failure closes only this fixed model and H5 label.
window_reporting: 126 consecutive eligible observed sessions, not necessarily consecutive exchange days; windows never cross fold seam; report annual and quarterly all including incomplete 2026.
